page.title: Speak on Echo
page.intro: CamStack reads the notification text aloud on the Echo devices you pick. Sign in with the Amazon account those devices use. Amazon may ask for a one-time code.

otp.title: Enter the code Amazon sent
otp.help: Open the authenticator app or the text Amazon sent, then type the code. It is used once.

captcha.title: Amazon asked for a captcha
captcha.help: This page cannot show Amazon's picture puzzle. Wait a few minutes, then sign in again.

devices.title: Echo devices
devices.help: Tick the devices or groups that should speak. A test uses the phrase below and does not change your rules.
devices.empty: No Echo devices yet. After you sign in, they show up here.
